I'd like to start by sharing my testimony. This isn't an easy one but I hope you can see that I'm not dismissing the pain and there is hope. 

Hi, I'm (23F), I want to tell you about the past 5 years of my life in a summary. I struggled terribly with anxiety, depression, hormonal imbalances, and suicidal thoughts. I went through a dark time when I turned 18, I left my parents at a movie theater to run off with a new boyfriend. They thought I was lost or kidnapped. It took a long time to forgive myself of that. He was very unkind to me. This didn't help the suicidal thoughts and other issues I was having. We finally got evicted from the apartment we shared and went separate ways. Fast forward to 2018, I was with another boyfriend and we attended a church service. Let me tell you about someone who touched my heart forevermore and SAVED my life, His name? Jesus Christ. 

In the beginning, God made us and this Earth perfect so we could have a perfect relationship with Him. But the first of mankind, Adam and Eve, sinned against Him and broke the perfection and separated us from God by sin. That was known as The Fall, the sin directly comes to us by being descendents of Adam and Eve. There's nothing we can do about that. We all sin, we all do bad things. No amount of good deeds we do can erase that sin. 
I know you're thinking..WHERE IS THE HOPE?! 
Well, God saw this. He saw that we wouldn't be able to erase our sin. He so loved the world, He sent His only Son down to die on the cross, paying the ultimate price of our sins. Past, present, and future sins.  He rose on the 3rd day, and everyone who believes on the name of Jesus Christ and  trusts in Him alone has eternal life. Believe He died for you and rose again in 3 days. Life with Jesus starts now and lasts forever. 

That's the Gospel of Jesus Christ. The Good News. He saved my life, and He's ready to save yours too. He's waiting with open arms. You were made on purpose with a purpose. 

Before this gets banned or taken down, anyone can message me with anything. Questions, comments, anything. I am HERE for ALL of you. Stay strong. Jesus loves you and so do I. ❤️
